For the first time in years, he ran down the stairs without his coat.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把梧桐的影子铺在人行道上，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下潮湿的微光。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃往上爬。远处偶有货车经过，声音很快沉入寂静。一个晚归的人停在桥边，看河水带走零碎的霓虹。天还没亮，生活已经轻轻翻身。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a toy.\n- A recursive program needs a stopping rule, like stopping when a box has no smaller box inside."}
